# Upcoming-event reminder

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Check the user-specified window; if none is given, use the next 24 hours in the user's or local time zone. Find known upcoming events and relevant unfinished preparation tasks, prioritizing the earliest time-sensitive event. Show known dates and times and identify missing calendar access. Offer one primary next action and an easy snooze or skip, without changing an event or task.
